packages.name: Workflow Review
packages.description: A focused BZS Software review that maps how work moves, finds bottlenecks, and identifies the three highest-leverage AI opportunities.
packages.best_for: Businesses that know manual work is costing time or money but need help choosing the first workflow to improve.
packages.next_step: Book a workflow review and bring one real process with examples.

packages.name: AI Opportunity Audit
packages.description: A deeper BZS analysis of where AI can reduce admin time, speed up decisions, or improve customer response across a business workflow.
packages.best_for: Teams that need a structured recommendation before investing in an AI workflow build.
packages.next_step: Define the workflow, current tools, and what a win would look like.

packages.name: Lead Reply & Qualification System
packages.description: A BZS-built workflow that helps respond to inbound leads, draft replies, qualify fit, prepare next steps, and keep follow-ups from slipping.
packages.best_for: Service businesses, agencies, and teams that lose revenue when lead replies or follow-ups are slow.
packages.next_step: Provide lead sources, response rules, handoff criteria, and current tools.

packages.name: Custom Workflow Integration
packages.description: A scoped BZS integration for systems such as CRMs, calendars, inboxes, payment tools, internal APIs, or document stores.
packages.best_for: Workflows that need AI to prepare or route real work inside existing business systems.
packages.next_step: Choose the first external system and define allowed read/write actions.

packages.name: Run & Tune
packages.description: Managed BZS support for measuring, tuning, and expanding an AI workflow after launch.
packages.best_for: Businesses that want the workflow to keep improving as the team and customer volume change.
packages.next_step: Confirm the target outcome, reporting cadence, and support expectations.
